reviewedState: base plus uncommitted daily-limit reset-boundary fix

finding.description: A daily-limit decision committed across JST midnight used the next day's midnight when rearming, delaying a fresh day's usable quota by nearly 24 hours.
finding.reviewedFix: Carry dailyResetAt from the quota decision transaction into rearm; use max(resetAt, currentTime, lastActivityAt + idleMs) and quiet-hour adjustment. Preserve public handleAlarm string outcome.
